prompt: A towering pylon built of corroded, soot-stained iron and fused slag, standing in a barren wasteland of grey ash and hardened dross. The pylon is a tall vertical industrial monolith, rivet-studded and oxidized with verdigris streaks, narrowing toward a jagged crown. Pale colorless diamond-grey mana energy vents from cracks and seams along its length and plumes from the crown, wisps of luminous ash-white light rising into the sky. The background is a flat desolate horizon of slag heaps under an overcast leaden sky, the pylon dominating the frame as a single dark vertical silhouette.

The background is a barren slag-heap horizon under a dim leaden sky. The pylon is the single dominant vertical silhouette in the frame.
